verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Gusto acting as an MCP client that can load external MCP servers and use their tools. The documented MCP items are servers that Gusto exposes to outside clients: the Embedded Dev Assistant MCP and the remote server at mcp.api.gusto.com, used by Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Gemini. The agent-friendly CLI is likewise driven by agents rather than hosting MCP servers. A SaaS platform with AI features could plausibly host MCP servers, so the axis applies, and the absence of evidence means none.
